exact_statement: Let G=(X,E) be a finite simple linear hypergraph with X equal to the union of its nonempty edges and maximum degree D, and put r=ceil(log_2(D+1))+1. For integers K>=1 and B>=3 satisfying min_e |e|>K, pi(B)-1>=r|X|, and 2r log_2 B+5<=K, construct in (2^K/32,2^K] one unequal-cardinality equal-product relation per edge so that each relation is a primitive circuit of its full prime-valuation matrix and pairwise support intersections, the edge-intersection graph, the matching number, and the transversal number agree exactly with G.
